decision: Alpha projection is no longer allowed to float as an independent knob.
rationale: If R10/Newton readout is in the resolved Fisher quotient basis, alpha_proj=0; otherwise the branch must declare an explicit eta_proj budget.

decision: Boundary and edge zeros are plausible but not currently parent-signed.
rationale: The archive still keeps boundary no-flux and R_edge/R_proj terms explicit, so deleting them would be a closure assumption.

decision: R10 can still be scored privately through an eta_R10 budget.
rationale: For any sourced eta_R10<1, the product gate becomes P_N <= 2*(1-eta_R10)*alpha_bound/lambda_H^4.
